name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1835: A sweep wrote its findings to disk once, after the last page of the last reel - so a sweep that died lost every read it had paid for, and the reel was not sealed either so the whole bill came again. Affordable at 21 pages; not at the 440 v1834 made reachable. Evidence is now banked every 20 pages, which is safe because a sighting is keyed by reel frame and lane so re-offering it folds to nothing. Also fixes v1833 reading his real journal into isolated test sweeps.
